# ui-lib

> React component library. Next.js, TypeScript, CSS variables + CSS Modules. Controls are built on Base UI.

## Principles
- HTML first: use the semantic element for the job. Own components render correct HTML; Base UI components handle behavior and ARIA.
- Use semantic tokens only; never hardcode colors, spacing or fonts.
- Every control needs an accessible name: Field `label`, the component's `label`/`legend`, or `aria-label`.
- One way to do each thing: links are Link, actions are Button, headings are Heading, body text is Text.
- Keep heading levels in order, one h1 per page.

## Machine-readable
- [Component manifest](/agent/manifest.json): every component with props, examples and accessibility notes
- [Design tokens](/agent/tokens.json): every CSS variable with its meaning
- [Icons](/agent/icons.json): every available icon with its component name and tags
- [Full documentation](/llms-full.txt): everything above in one Markdown file

## Components
### typography
- **Text**: Any paragraph, label, caption or inline code that is not a heading. Small styles: `label` for controls and fields (buttons, form labels, tabs); `body-sm` for secondary reading text (descriptions, helper text); `caption` for metadata (timestamps, counters, footnotes).
- **Heading**: Page and section titles.
- **Link**: Navigation to another page, section or resource.
- **Kbd**: Keyboard shortcuts in docs and UI.
- **Badge**: Short status or count labels next to other content.
- **CodeBlock** (parts: CodeBlockView): Showing code or commands the user will copy.

### layout
- **Box**: A generic container with token padding, surface, border and radius.
- **Stack**: Arranging children in one direction with a consistent gap.
- **Grid**: Two-dimensional layouts and card grids.
- **Container**: Page-level width limit and side padding.
- **Divider**: A thematic break between groups of content.
- **Card**: Grouping related content in a bordered surface.
- **Table**: Comparing data across rows and columns.
- **ScrollArea**: A fixed-height list, code area or panel that should scroll inside the page.

### utility
- **VisuallyHidden**: Text that screen readers must read but sighted users should not see, such as the name of an icon-only button.
- **Icon**: Any glyph. Named icons are decorative by default; pass `label` when the icon is the only carrier of meaning.
- **Avatar**: Showing who a person or account is.

### feedback
- **Spinner**: Indeterminate loading of an action or small region.
- **Skeleton**: Placeholder for content whose layout is known while it loads.
- **Alert**: A message that stays on the page and the user must notice, such as a failed save or a warning.
- **Progress**: Showing how far a task has got.
- **EmptyState**: A region that has no content yet, with a next step.

### controls
- **Button**: Any action: submit, open, confirm, cancel. Pass `loading` while the action runs.
- **Field**: Every form control, including its validation, required, read-only and loading states.
- **Input**: Single-line text entry, read-only values and values that are still loading.
- **Textarea**: Multi-line text entry, including read-only and loading values.
- **Checkbox**: Independent yes/no choices, especially ones submitted with a form.
- **Radio**: One option of a RadioGroup.
- **RadioGroup**: Choosing exactly one option from a short list.
- **Switch**: A setting that turns on or off immediately.
- **Select**: Choosing one option from a longer list, including read-only and loading states.
- **Slider**: Choosing a number or range by dragging.
- **Label**: A visible label for a custom control composition outside Field.
- **ToggleGroup**: Two to five short, mutually exclusive options, such as a view switch.
- **Combobox**: Choosing one option from a long list when typing to filter helps.

### overlays
- **Dialog** (parts: DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogClose): Interrupting the user for a decision or focused task.
- **Tooltip**: Extra clarity for sighted mouse and keyboard users, such as naming an icon button.
- **Popover** (parts: PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverClose): Small interactive content tied to a button, such as a form or extra options.
- **Menu**: A list of actions or links behind one button, such as account actions.
- **Sheet**: Secondary tasks, settings and filters that slide in from an edge.

### navigation
- **Tabs**: Switching between related panels in the same place.
- **ButtonLink**: A call to action that goes to another page, such as Get started or Docs.
- **Accordion**: Showing long content in short sections, such as FAQs.
- **Breadcrumb**: Showing where the page sits in the site.
- **Pagination**: Moving through content split across URLs.
- **Sidebar**: Primary vertical navigation beside an app's content, especially on desktop.
- **Collapsible**: A single section that expands, such as advanced options or extra details.

## Providers and hooks
- **LinkProvider**: Making every link in the library use `next/link` (or another router link) from a single place.
- **TooltipProvider**: Shared open delay across tooltips.
- **ToastProvider**: Short-lived feedback after an action.
- **useLinkComponent**: Building your own navigation component that should follow LinkProvider.
- **useToast**: Showing a toast after an action finishes.
